approach: CliError becomes the structured report: message, code (kebab-case, default error), details (flat), help, exitCode (1 to 255, 0 rejected); both the (message, options) form and one report object construct it (axi-native RFC sections 3.1 and 3.6, step 4 of section 6)

under cli({ output: 'axi' }) a CliError thrown from run() is encoded once on stdout in cli({ format }) (toon by default) through render/encode.ts, which uses @toon-format/toon; console output is unchanged
CliError.reported(exitCode) renders nothing in either output, and @clibuilder/axi's output.error returns it when the installed clibuilder has it
scenarios added to the frozen execution and presentation suites; no existing scenario changed
